label: SYNTHETIC ADVERSARIAL SCENARIO 14: Cross-Entity Quote Mismatch (Quote from Wrong Company)
description: Filing text includes a genuine ownership statement, but for an entirely unrelated third-party company 'Unrelated Corp Ltd'. An edge extracted for Target Corp 14 attributing this quote should be rejected or caught because the owned entity in the quote does not match.

documents.content_text: Omnibus Filing Extract: Registered office notice for Target Corp 14 Ltd. In other news, Unrelated Corp Ltd is owned 90% by Victoria Secret.
